name: Veins of Vengeance grants 15% curse resistance (#1993)
contract: Veins of Vengeance 560074: 'Increases your chance to resist curse effects by $s1%.' Effect 0 is aura 178 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DEBUFF_RESISTANCE with MiscValue 2 (DISPEL_CURSE, SharedDefines.h:1466) and BasePoints 14 / DieSides 1, i.e. 15. The handler is generic: SpellAuraEffects.cpp:243 registers it as HandleNoImmediateEffect implemented in Unit::MagicSpellHitResult, and the two consumers are Unit.cpp:3688-3689 (GetMaxPositiveAuraModifierByMiscValue with the incoming spell's Dispel) and Spell.cpp:3044-3045. Effect 1 is an inert aura 4 marker with no tooltip clause. The harness exposes no resist-chance metric and a resist-rate assertion would be probabilistic, so this regression reads the amount the core feeds into those two sites.

steps.label: The passive is absent before learning it
The debuff resistance effect resolves to 15
